title: Continuous integration on every push and pull request
description: There is no .github/workflows directory. Add a workflow that runs on pushes to main and on pull requests: build, go vet, formatting check, lint, unit tests, and the Playwright suites (main, multi-club, and fresh-install once Sprint 020 lands) with reports uploaded on failure. Fix the lint setup first: .golangci.yml is in v1 format while `make lint` installs the latest (v2) release - migrate the config and pin the version. Pin third-party actions by commit. Add Dependabot or Renovate for Go modules, actions and the Playwright image.

recommended_model.name: Sonnet 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Standard workflow authoring with known tools.

acceptance_criteria: A pull request shows separate checks for lint, unit tests and e2e, all required for merge on main
golangci-lint is pinned and its config is valid for the pinned version; `make lint` and CI use the same version
Playwright HTML report and traces are uploaded as artifacts when e2e fails
Third-party actions are pinned to commit SHAs; workflow permissions are read-only by default
Total CI time for a typical pull request is recorded, with caching for Go modules and the Playwright image
A dependency update tool opens grouped update pull requests

notes: Pushing workflow files needs a GitHub token with the `workflow` scope - Jim's gh token has lacked it before; check before the first push.
E2E currently runs through docker compose; CI can call the same make targets.

testing_requirements: Open a pull request with a deliberate lint error and a failing test to confirm both are caught

context.user_story: As the maintainer, I want every change tested automatically before it can reach a club.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
